For a 2-adult weekend, these are three currently listed options around Hyderabad. Prices are indicative for 1 night and can change by date. 
Thrillophilia
+1

Resort	Current listed price	What’s included / limitation	Switching difficulty
Mrugavani Resort & Spa	~₹4,399/night	Stay package; meals/activities depend on package	Low
Brown Town Resort, Spa & Convention	~₹5,299/night	Stay; spa/food may be extra	Low
The Golkonda Resorts & Spa	~₹8,599/night	Stay package; weekend all-meals offer available, alcohol excluded	Medium

Thrillophilia currently lists these 2D/1N package prices, while Golkonda's own site confirms its weekend package and direct-booking offers. 
Thrillophilia
+1

Practical switching: Mrugavani ↔ Brown Town is relatively easy because both are similar-priced resort stays. Moving to Golkonda increases the budget materially and may involve stricter package conditions. For two adults, compare the final checkout total, meals, cancellation terms and taxes, not just headline room price.

For a 50-person Indian company, I’d shortlist myBiz, Trip.Biz and Yatra Travel Pro, but the right choice depends heavily on how much travel is actually managed offline.

Purchase-ready shortlist
Option	Cost position	Key trade-off	Best fit
MakeMyTrip myBiz	No annual subscription; negotiated service fee + applicable GST; 1.5% payment-gateway fee can apply. 
MakeMyTrip
+1
	Strong self-serve platform and Indian inventory, but some GST/refund processes depend on supplier.	Best starting point for a 50-person Indian SME
Trip.Biz	Custom quote; insist on transaction/offline/after-hours fees in writing.	Stronger managed/global support, but pricing isn't publicly transparent. 24/7 human support and emergency assistance are advertised. 
Trip.biz
	International travel + employees needing human support
Yatra Travel Pro	Custom quote; intended for companies under 2,500 trips or ₹5 crore annual travel spend. 
Yatra.com
	More conventional corporate controls; 24/7 dedicated desk is positioned under Travel Elite, not Pro.	India-heavy travel with approvals/MIS
What I'd put in the PO/RFP

Require an all-in quote for 500 bookings/year, including:

booking + offline-agent fee

cancellation/refund fee

amendment/reissue fee

payment/card charges

GST invoice collection charges

implementation/integration fees

after-hours support

refund SLA

credit period

exit/minimum-contract terms

Most important: myBiz's published terms explicitly say its service fee is mutually agreed, while the separate 1.5% payment-gateway charge can sit on top. 
MakeMyTrip

For a 50-person company, I would request quotes from all three using exactly the same 500-booking + 50-cancellation + 75-change scenario. That will reveal the actual TCO rather than comparing headline fares.
